newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling slides against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling slides against the dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling weakened against the dollar on Wednesday because of a shortage of dollar supply from commercial banks, dealers said.

The shilling traded at a commercial mean rate of 616.7700 compared with 614.7900 on Tuesday and at 1005.9550 to the pound sterling compared with 1005.1848. The shilling has been sliding against the dollar since May 20 when it closed at 610.0830.
